ov: Large domesticated grazers, first tamed from the wild aurochs about 10,500 years ago. Kept for meat, milk and leather and for pulling loads, there were over 940 million cattle in the world in 2022.

why.dg: In a herd, cows with young calves are often more dangerous to people than you might expect.

rg: Worldwide. Taurine cattle in temperate regions, zebu in India and the tropics, and sanga cattle in sub-Saharan Africa.
df: Grass and other plants. Cattle are ruminants: one large stomach with four compartments ferments tough plant material.
fx: Cows can sort pictures of other cattle into familiar and unfamiliar individuals.
